about: Machine-readable record of Super Intelligence (SI) tool use in this repo, as the NASA Space Apps submission guide asks. Human-readable log: SI_USAGE.md. Rules and labels: SI_DISCLOSURE.md.

si.assisted: written or edited with an SI tool, reviewed and merged by the team
si.generated: the content itself was produced by an SI tool (images and video need a visible watermark)
si.none: made by people without SI tools
si.unknown: not recorded yet; the team member who added it fills it in

files.notes: Unchanged NASA DONKI responses, downloaded by an SI tool. The values are NASA's, not SI-made.
